Automated Model Briefing

⚠ AI-generated text — may be wrong, incomplete, or overconfident. This is automated commentary on experimental model output, not flight advice and not a weather forecast. It has not been reviewed by a meteorologist.

Overall Assessment — Marginal showery day with N/NW flow 10–22 mph, sharp lapse rates (9.9 °C/km regional), and high overdevelopment at most sites. The best dry thermal window is at Rainbow Ridge; rain, cloud overdevelopment, and low-level shear limit other launches.

Site Breakdown

  • Kingsbury grade: Marginal — rain, 77% overdevelopment, and mostly off-preferred N winds; preferred window 10am–1pm with peak w* 350 ft/min and thermal ceiling 3,159 ft AGL; sharp thermals (8.6 °C/km) — advanced only.
  • Hallelujah: Marginal — dry but 86% overdevelopment and off-preferred N/NW winds; preferred window 10am–3pm with peak w* 330 ft/min and thermal ceiling 3,246 ft AGL; sharp thermals (8.4 °C/km) — advanced only.
  • Slide Mountain: Marginal — rain and 86% overdevelopment limit an early thermal pulse; preferred window 8am–1pm with peak w* 292 ft/min and thermal ceiling 1,997 ft AGL; lapse 7.2 °C/km.
  • McClellan: Marginal — rain and off-preferred N winds, but lower 27% overdevelopment; preferred window 9am–3pm with peak w* 359 ft/min and thermal ceiling 3,173 ft AGL; sharp thermals (8.3 °C/km) — advanced only.
  • West McClellan: Unfavorable — rain and 95% overdevelopment; brief 9am–1pm at best with peak w* 290 ft/min and thermal ceiling 2,062 ft AGL; lapse 7.9 °C/km.
  • Peavine Mountain: Unfavorable — 100% overdevelopment and rain; 8am–1pm at best with peak w* 214 ft/min and thermal ceiling 1,475 ft AGL; lapse 6.8 °C/km.
  • Rainbow Ridge: Favorable — dry, 23% cloud cover, and 0% overdevelopment; preferred window 10am–3pm with peak w* 343 ft/min and thermal ceiling 3,452 ft AGL; sharp thermals (8.6 °C/km) — advanced only.
  • Duck Hill: Marginal — favorable N wind but rain and 59% overdevelopment; preferred window 8am–3pm with peak w* 336 ft/min and thermal ceiling 4,125 ft AGL; sharp thermals (9.3 °C/km) — advanced only.
  • Daydreams: Unfavorable — rain, 82% overdevelopment, low-level shear, and strong N gusts; no reliable window; peak w* 330 ft/min and thermal ceiling 3,912 ft AGL; sharp thermals (8.8 °C/km).

Hazards

  • Rain/showers: Regional peak precipitation 7.5 mm/hr; rain flagged at Kingsbury, Slide, McClellan, West McClellan, Peavine, Duck Hill, and Daydreams.
  • Overdevelopment: High at Hallelujah (86%), Slide (86%), West McClellan (95%), Peavine (100%), Daydreams (82%), Kingsbury (77%), and Duck Hill (59%).
  • Low-level shear: Daydreams has bulk shear 26 mph and peak layer speed shear 5 mph at 743 ft AGL (hazardous threshold ≥5 mph/layer).
  • Rotor/lee: Rotor/lee turbulence possible downwind of Peavine Mountain and Carson Range ridgelines with N/NW flow 10–22 mph.
  • Icing: Freezing level 7,771 ft MSL; domain-wide thermal ceiling reaches 12,422 ft MSL, so high climbs could encounter icing.

Site Forecast ?Top of Thermals (PBLH) — height of the turbulent mixing layer; thermals typically reach this ceiling.
LCL (Lifted Condensation Level) — altitude where rising air reaches its dew point; theoretical cloud base.
Cloud Base — lowest model level with >10% cloud fraction.
w* — convective velocity scale; higher = stronger thermals (ft/min).
Cloud Cover — max cloud fraction over the column (0–100%).
Wind thresholds: orange = 12 mph, red = 18 mph.
